title: Finish ICM on your L1
summary: Deploy the Teleporter registry, then check the relayer
description: Completes ICM on an L1 whose Quick L1 launch stopped after the chain was live: deploys a TeleporterRegistry that points at the chain's TeleporterMessenger, records it on the project, and walks through getting a relayer that serves the L1 and the C-Chain.
prompts: My L1 launch stopped before the ICM registry was deployed, finish it
Set up the Teleporter registry on my L1
Make my L1 ready for ICM and ICTT blueprints

l1.description: Your L1, bound from the Networks tab

cchain.description: Chain the relayer connects your L1 to

prerequisites: Your L1 is bound to the project and has a TeleporterMessenger (the L1 was launched with interoperability, or ICM was set up in the console)
The signing wallet holds native gas on the L1: the owner set at launch receives the genesis allocation

contracts.name: TeleporterRegistry
contracts.description: Versioned registry of Teleporter protocol addresses that ICM apps and ICTT contracts read

steps.title: Deploy the Teleporter registry on your L1
Make sure a relayer serves your L1 and the C-Chain

review: The registry lists exactly one protocol version, pointing at the chain's canonical TeleporterMessenger, which the binding confirmed has code.
Nothing in the registry is upgradable by anyone but the registry's own addProtocolVersion, which is unrestricted by design: apps pick which versions to trust.
The relayer step only confirms one exists. A relayer with no gas, or one that does not list both chains, delivers nothing.

frontend.summary: A readiness check for the L1's cross-chain features: registry in place, relayer serving both chains.
audience: The builder's team checking the L1 is ready for cross-chain apps
End users only indirectly: apps hide cross-chain features until this passes
journeys: A short checklist with a green or amber state per item and what to do next.
In end-user apps, hide or disable cross-chain actions ('Cross-chain transfers are coming soon') until the checklist passes.
flows: Read latestVersion() and getAddressFromVersion(latestVersion()) on the registry to confirm ICM is ready before showing any cross-chain feature.
Link the managed relayer page so the builder can add the L1 and the C-Chain to a relayer and fund it.
